title: Canary rollback does not erase interruptions
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Fail a canary; failed journeys remain interruptions despite successful rollback.
preconditions: JavaScript enabled; local file access to the standalone lesson
Eight fixed synthetic clients and a ready retained old-v1 destination
One measured 25 or 50 percent canary stage; illustrative 250 ms journey budget
syntheticInput: 16 allowlisted configurations, 2 or 4 attempted transition journeys per stage, 6 retained checked attempts
expectedAssertions: Failed or unknown canary evidence stops admission and rejects expansion
Confirmed synthetic reversal restores observed old routing
Failed and unknown original journeys remain counted after successful recovery
Old-only comparisons and separate recovery checks never inflate the transition numerator or denominator
Missing rollback evidence leaves effective routing and recovery UNKNOWN
A correct failure prediction passes learning verification without changing user-impact FAILURE
limits: One measured stage; an eligible next stage is not executed
All canary, failure, expansion and rollback actions are teaching-trace data only
No native Azure canary, rollback, routing, authentication or user-continuity certification
No source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 validation or five-nines claim
Bounded memory-only history; reset or reload deliberately clears all local data
